text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0}, Illya, and Ruka were chasing the monster and man duo when suddenly they found themselves on the path to the temple.
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物を追っていた{0}とイリヤ、ルカの３人は、
気が付けば神殿へ向かう参道にいた。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Looks like he's up ahead.
text_block_list.orig_text: この先におるようじゃな。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: A monster lurking in a temple that's supposed to be sacred at this time of year. How disrespectful.
text_block_list.orig_text:
神聖であるはずの神殿に
魔物が潜むとは
おだやかじゃあないねえ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: You're right... Hm! Over there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
たしかにそうじゃのう……
む！
あそこじゃ！

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Things are going well. Right? How are you feeling, partner?
text_block_list.orig_text:
順調に集まってるぜ。
なあ？　
どうだ、具合は？

text_block_list.name: Cow Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Alright, it looks like you have enough power. This year has been strange from the beginning. No one would ever believe that you, a cow monster, would obtain power because you ate a lot of lucky food meant for the Year of the Ox.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし、
力は十分なようだな。
今年は最初からおかしな年だったぜ。
牛の魔物のお前が丑年の縁起物を食ったせいでパワーもアップした、
なんて誰も信じなかったからなあ。

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Well, whatever... Thanks to you, I had a great time this past year.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあいいさ……
おかげでオレはこの一年間、
いい思いをさせてもらったぜ。

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: However, we don't know what the next year will bring. So, eat plenty of auspicious foods during the Year of the Ox to build up your strength...
text_block_list.orig_text:
とはいえ、
来年はどうなるかわからねえ。
だから、
丑年のうちに縁起物をたっぷり食べて力を蓄えるんだ……

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: If we do that, we'll surely be able to make a big splash next year too! However, it would have been quicker to just steal them like this from the start, rather than going to the trouble of buying them all up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうすりゃあ来年も大暴れできるにちがいねえ！
しっかし、
わざわざ買い占めなんざするより
最初からこうして奪っちまった方が早かったな！

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you, partner. I'd be in trouble if you didn't work hard to make up for the investment I made.
text_block_list.orig_text:
頼むぜぇ、
相棒よ。
投資した分はしっかり働いてくれねえと困るからなあ。

text_block_list.name: Cow Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Looks like they haven't noticed us. Still, I see... Now I understand why he was buying up all kinds of lucky charm food or even stealing them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうやら
こちらには気づいてないようだね。
しかし、
なるほどねえ……
縁起物を
買い占めや強奪で集めてる理由は
分かったよ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: What should we do, should we take back everything all at once...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうする？
このまま一気に奪い返すかの？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: That's right. However, we can't get started until the main character arrives. I'll keep an eye on them right here. {0}, you and Illya go find Sheffy and bring her here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね。
肝心の主役が来なけりゃ始まらない。
アタシはここであいつらを見張っておくよ。
お前さんとイリヤは
シェフィを捜して連れてきておくれ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: We were able to find these guys right away using Illya's familiars, but I'm sure she's having a hard time finding them on her own.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシたちは
イリヤの眷属を使って
こいつらをすぐに見つけられたが、
シェフィだけだと
難儀してるだろうからねえ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: All right, got it. Don't let those two get away, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいわかった。
逃がすでないぞ？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Sheffy was walking along the path where the monster had run away.
text_block_list.orig_text: シェフィは魔物の駆け去った道をひたすらに歩いていた。

text_block_list.name: シェフィ
text_block_list.text:
はぁ……
諦めない……
絶対に……
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
諦めない……
絶対に……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I used ice magic to cool and stabilize my ankle, so it doesn't hurt anymore, but... I've no idea if I'm on the right track to where that villain and his monster were headed...
text_block_list.orig_text:
足首は
氷魔法で冷やして
固定したから
もう痛みはないけど……
あの人たちが向かったのが
こっちで合ってるかは分からない。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Even so, I won't stop here. No, I can’t stop...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでも、
立ち止まらない。
ううん、
立ち止まれない……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Sheffy, I see you've come this far on your own. Good work.
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィよ。
ここまで来ておったか。
よく頑張ったのう。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Illya-san? Even {0}... Why are you here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
イリヤさん？　
{0}まで……
どうしてここに？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, our precious ingredients were lost because of me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんなさい、
私のせいで、
大切な荷物が……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: There's no need to be so humble and dejected. You did well on your own. Follow us. What you're looking for is just ahead.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みなまで言わずともよい。
よくぞ一人で頑張ったのう。
ついてまいれ。
探し物はこのすぐ先じゃ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Ahead, what do you mean...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それって
どういうこと……？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Welcome. You're here much earlier than I expected. Yeah, it looks like you'll be fine. Your eyes show some spirit.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よく来たね。
思ってたよりも
ずいぶんと早いじゃないか。
うん、
大丈夫そうだね。
まだ眼は死んじゃいない。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Ruka-san too... I see, you were watching me. I'm sorry, it was my carelessness that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルカさんも……
そっか、
私のこと、
見ててくれてたのね。
ごめんなさい、
私の不注意で……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: I'll stop you right there, it was my own carelessness that let them escape too. I'm the one who should be apologizing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そのうえで
あいつらを逃がしちまったんだ。
謝るのは
こっちのほうさ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I appreciate that you've told me their location, but I can't ask you to lend me an hand any more than this... This is something I have to do...
text_block_list.orig_text:
場所を教えてくれたことにはお礼を言うわ。
でも、
これ以上手を借りるわけにはいかない……
これは、
私がやらなくちゃいけないことだから……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Lend you an hand? What are you talking about?
text_block_list.orig_text:
手を貸す？　
何のことじゃ？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Eh?
text_block_list.orig_text: え？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: The three of us just came here to get rid of the bad guys. What's happening here is that you and us merely share the same goal.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシたちは
ただ悪党を退治しに来ただけさ。
アンタとは
たまたま目的が同じだけ、
ってね。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: We want to make up for our mistakes just like you. Even if you say no, we'll still follow you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
失態を取り戻したいのは
わらわたちも同じじゃ。
ダメと言うてもついてゆくぞ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: But... I wonder if it's okay. I have to take responsibility for it myself...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも……
いいのかしら。
私が自分で責任をとらなくちゃいけないのに……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Don't sweat the small stuff. Just think of it as entertaining the whims of a legendary vampire.
text_block_list.orig_text:
細かいことは気にするでない。
伝説の吸血鬼の気まぐれとでも思っておれ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: This sword is asking for it. To give me the blood of the villains.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この刀が求めてるのさ。
悪党どもの血をよこせ、
ってね。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Thank you, you three...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう、
３人とも……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.orig_text: うん！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: That's a good answer.
text_block_list.orig_text: いい返事だ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: I'll make them rue the day that they've laid a hand upon Sheffy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィに手を出したこと、
後悔させてやろう。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Phew, that's great... It looks like they managed to meet up safely.
text_block_list.orig_text:
は～、
よかったぁ……
なんとか無事合流できたみたいね。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Watching over her all this time was so hard... I can't count how many times I've tried to help her get here. But all I could do was hold myself back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
見守るって、
大変なんですね……
何回助けに行こうとしちゃったことか。
我慢するので精一杯でしたよ。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Yes... That said, Lady Sheffy's hard work was admirable.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい……
ですがシェフィさまの頑張りは
それはお見事でございました。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: By the way, why are the three of us still hiding?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ところで、
さ。
なんであたしたちまだ隠れてんの？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: To watch over Lady Sheffy, of course...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは
シェフィさまを見守るため……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: But she already met up with {0} and those two, so it's a little late for that, isn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}たちと合流しちゃったんだし、
いまさらじゃない？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: That's true... Well then, let's go join them right away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それもそうですね……
じゃあ
今から合流しちゃいましょっか！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: But... will that really be fine? If we were to do that, won't Lady Sheffy find out about our disguises?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
よろしいのでしょうか。
そうなると
わたくしたちの変装のことも
シェフィさまに知られてしまうのでは……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: That would certainly be a little embarrassing... But, but, I think it's also important to laugh at each other's embarrassing moments!
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かにそれはちょっと恥ずかしいですけど……
でもでも、
お互いの恥ずかしい出来事を笑い合うのも
大切だと思いますから！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Eh, no... I don't want her to know that it was me in that stupid outfit... Absolutely not...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
やだ……
あのバカみたいな格好したのが
あたしだってバレるのはやだ……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Eeeh? Kyaru-chan, I thought that disguise suited you perfectly. Right, Kokkoro-chan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えー、
キャルちゃんとっても似合ってましたよ？
ねえ、
コッコロちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Yes. She looked very lovely.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい。
とても愛らしいお姿でございましたよ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: That's fine and all, but what matters here is what I think! And for the record, I don't want to! We'll stay here and watch over Sheffy! Got it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうのいいから！
とにかく
あたしはいやよ！
ここでシェフィを見守る！　
いいわね！

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Alright, alright. Looks like you've eaten everything I've bought. Now, next up is what I've stolen...
text_block_list.orig_text:
よしよし。
買い占めてきた分は全部食べたようだな。
じゃあ次はこの
盗んできた……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...A lucky charm exists to make connections and to bless those living in this world. There is no merit to be gained by buying up and stealing things and putting them in one's stomach.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一つ人の世渡世の義理と、
縁を結ぶが縁起物。
買い占め盗んで腹に入れども
得られる功徳は
ありゃしない。

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Wh-What the hell!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんだぁ！？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Take witness. This legendary vampire has taken notice of your villainy. I hope you're prepared for what's coming to you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
主らの暴虐、
この伝説の吸血鬼が確かに見届けた。
覚悟はできておろうなあ？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: And this doesn't concern just us... I'll be taking back everyone's fun New Year's holidays!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちだけじゃない……
みんなの楽しいお正月、
返してもらうわ。

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Shit, what on earth is this about? To you guys, this is just food. Why are you so desperate for something like that?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
クソ、
なんだってんだまったく！
お前たちにとっちゃこんなもの、
ただの飯の材料だろうが。
なにそんなもんに必死になってやがんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: You wouldn't understand the meaning of those words even if you tried... You're the one who treats lucky charms so poorly, even though you should be grateful for their blessings.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そいつは
アンタには分かんないだろうねえ……
ありがたいはずの縁起物を
そんなに粗末に扱う
アンタにはね。

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Shut up! Hey, partner! It's about time we let them have it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うるせえ！
おい相棒！　
返り討ちだ！

text_block_list.name: Cow Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Hmm... It seems to have gotten bigger since before. Maybe it's because it has absorbed the power of the lucky charm or something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
むう……
先ほどよりも
何やら大きくなっておるのう。
縁起物の力とやらを
とりこんだせいじゃろうか。

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's exactly right! Against you weaklings there's no way he would lose!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
その通りだぜ！
お前らなんぞに負けるわけがないんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: This guy's tougher than I thought. So how about you all folks? Are you scared of those two?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こいつは思ってたより手ごわそうだねぇ。
どうだいお前さんたち、
怖気づいちまったかい？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Yeah. No matter how strong they are... I won't give up! Let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん。
どんなに強い相手だろうと……
私は、
私たちは諦めない！
いくわよ！

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: How stingy! Get 'em!
text_block_list.orig_text:
しゃらくせえ！
けちらせぇ！

text_block_list.name: Cow Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Gwah?! Wh-Why... me...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐほぁっ！？
な、
なんで……
俺を……

text_block_list.name: Cow Monster
text_block_list.text: Me strong... You, shut up. Weakling.
text_block_list.orig_text:
オレ、
スゴクツヨイ……
オマエウルサイ、
ヨウズミ。

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Damn... it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちく、
しょうがあ……

text_block_list.name: Cow Monster
text_block_list.text: Bring it... ON!
text_block_list.orig_text:
タオシテ……
クラウ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Tch! So fast!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちぃっ！　
速い！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I'll freeze him in his tracks so he stops moving. Just like I did at the beach... EVERYTHING...! I'LL FREEZE IT!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
凍らせて動きを止めるわ。
海の時みたいに……
全部
凍らせる！！

text_block_list.name: Cow Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: No way! It didn't stop him...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うそっ！　
止まらない……？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Perhaps thanks to his acquired holy powers he's getting his strength amplified due to the nearby temple...
text_block_list.orig_text:
入り混じった聖なる力が
神殿の神気で増大されておるのやもしれんな。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Sounds more troublesome than I thought.
text_block_list.orig_text:
思っていたよりも
厄介そうだねえ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Then what can I even do...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いったい
どうしたら……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Don't worry. He's not the only one here who has mastery over the powers of both light and darkness... Let's go! {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
案ずるでないわ。
光と闇を兼ね備えておるのは
そやつだけではない……
ゆくぞ！　{0}！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Following the Holy Night and the Black Night, here comes the legendary vampire Illya Ornstein, who rules over the new year that comes and the old year that passes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
聖なる夜と
漆黒の夜に次ぎ、
生まれ来る新年と去りゆく旧年を統べし
伝説の吸血鬼
イリヤ・オーンスタイン見参じゃ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: My true power... HAVE A TASTE!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わらわの真の力……
味わうがいいっ！

text_block_list.name: Cow Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Amazing... So this is Illya-san's true power...
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごい……
これが、
イリヤさんの本気……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Did I get him...?
text_block_list.orig_text: やったか……？

text_block_list.name: Cow Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: NOT YET! ILLYA!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだだっ！　
イリヤ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: NGH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぬうっ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Illya-san!!
text_block_list.orig_text: イリヤさん！！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: I couldn't kill him... Even though I put all my magical power into it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
仕留めきれなんだか……
全魔力をつぎ込んだというのに。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: So you were able to dodge that in time because you got smaller, huh? Man, talk about a close call...
text_block_list.orig_text:
小さくなっちまったおかげで避けられたのかい。
まったく、
肝が冷えるねえ……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: The opponent's strength has been reduced by at most 20 to 30 percent...
text_block_list.orig_text:
相手の削げた力は
せいぜい２、３割か……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: That alone is quite an accomplishment. This temple also receives prayers from worshippers in preparation for the New Year holidays...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それだけでも
たいしたもんさね。
この神殿には
年末年始に向けて
参拝者の祈りも集まってる……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: It seems that they're in a bit of a pinch!
text_block_list.orig_text: なんだかピンチですよ！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Lady Sheffy, My Lord...
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィさま、
主さま……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: As her guardians, we should just be watching her growth from here... right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
保護者としては
ここは見守るべき……
なのよね？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: That's ridiculous! I mean, the three of us, we're her comrades, not her guardians! Of course we're going to save her!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなのおかしいです！
だってわたしたちは
保護者じゃなくて仲間なんですから！
助けに行くに決まってます！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: But then, have you stopped to think about Sheffy's own feelings?! She's fighting tooth and nail for our sake here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあシェフィの気持ちはどうなるのよ！
あたしたちのためにって、
必死に立ち向かってるのよ！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: If that's the issue at hand, I have a good idea.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでしたら、
名案がございます。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Aaah...!
text_block_list.orig_text: あぁっ……！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Geh...

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ、
参りましょう！

text_block_list.name: Cow Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Doesn't it seem like that thing's getting stronger by the minute?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだか、
どんどんと回復していってないかい？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Looks like it... This must be because of the power of the temple...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そのようじゃの……
これも
神殿の力のせいか……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: No way... we can't win like this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな……
このままじゃ
勝てないわ……

text_block_list.name: Disguised Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Hohoho, mayhaps you need some help?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほっほっほ、
助けが必要ですかな？

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: We're here to help.
text_block_list.orig_text: お助けに参りました。

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kyaru
text_block_list.text: Ah, geez...
text_block_list.orig_text: あーもう……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: This voice...!
text_block_list.orig_text: この声は……！

text_block_list.name: Disguised Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Merely an old man passing by!
text_block_list.orig_text: ただの通りすがりの老人ですじゃ！

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Merely an old woman passing by.
text_block_list.orig_text: 通りすがりの老婆でございます。

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kyaru
text_block_list.text: Merely a passing by... passerby!
text_block_list.orig_text:
通りすがりの……
通りすがりよ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: You're a welcome sight! We're about to launch an all-out assault! Lend us your strength!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よく来た！
総攻撃をかける！　
力を貸せい！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Um, these people are...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの、
この人たちって……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Forget it and let's go, Sheffy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいからいくよ、
シェフィ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: We will destroy the opponent's guard! Then we'll leave the rest to you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わらわたちが相手を崩す！
後は任せるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: All right... Please, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わかったわ……
お願い、{0}！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: This feels nice... I'm filled with power. I don't think I'll lose to anyone now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいねぇ……
力がみなぎってきたよ。
これなら負ける気がしないね。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Now then. The real battle begins from now on!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて、
ここからが本番じゃぞ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: It's not just {0}... Everyone's giving me strength! With this, I'll...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}だけじゃない……
みんなが私に力をくれる！
これなら！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: First up, let me clear your way... HAAAAH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずは
アタシが露払いといこうか……
ハアアアッ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Snow Sword·Winter Emperor - LIGHT SNOW!
text_block_list.orig_text:
雪の太刀
・冬帝　
細雪！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: That's some splendid swordsmanship. Then let me show you my true strength once again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
見事な剣の冴えじゃのう。
ならばもう一度、
わらわの真の力を見せようぞ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: VERMILION RISING...!
text_block_list.orig_text: ヴァーミリオンライジング！

text_block_list.name: Cow Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: He's charging at us while getting hit!? {0}! Your strengthening did its course! Dodge!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くらいながら
突進してきたっ！？
{0}！　
アタシたちの強化はいい！　
よけな！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Kwahahaha! You've got some guts! That's why you're my familiar! Ruka, we'll make sure to divert this attack instead!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くははははっ！　
いい度胸じゃ！
それでこそ我が眷属よ！
ルカよ、
わらわたちで攻撃をそらすぞ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Geez, how reckless can you be! Haaaah!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まったく、
無茶するねえ！
はあああっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Sheffy! We'll leave the rest to you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィ！　
あとは頼んだよ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Yes! {0} put his body on the line to give me this chance... I won't miss it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい！
{0}が作ってくれたチャンス……
逃さない！

text_block_list.name: Disguised Pecorine
text_block_list.text: We'll leave the timing up to you!
text_block_list.orig_text: タイミングはお任せしますぞ！

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Please go ahead whenever you're ready!
text_block_list.orig_text: いつでもきてくださいまし！

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kyaru
text_block_list.text: Go as far as you like!
text_block_list.orig_text: 存分にいきなさい！

text_block_list.name: Cow Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Right here... right now! Everyone, come with me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今……
ここよ！
みんな、
あわせて！

text_block_list.name: Disguised Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text: いきます！

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!
text_block_list.orig_text: はあああ！

text_block_list.name: Disguised Kyaru
text_block_list.text: YouuUUUUUUUUUUUU!
text_block_list.orig_text: このおおおお！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Everyone's feelings...! I'll put them into this sword...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなの想いを、
この剣に……！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!
text_block_list.orig_text: いっけぇええええ！！

text_block_list.name: Cow Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Cow Monster
text_block_list.text: My power... is waning... My past... is catching... up to me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
チカラガ……
ヌケテユク……
オレノトシガ
オワッテユク……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Did we get him?
text_block_list.orig_text: 倒せたの？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Looks like it...
text_block_list.orig_text: そのようじゃの……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Everyone, good work... Wait, what? Where did those three even go?
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなお疲れ……
って、
おや？
３人は
どこにいったんだい？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Looks like they've already left.
text_block_list.orig_text: もう立ち去ったようじゃの。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Those people from earlier... they were Pecorine and the others, after all...
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきの人たちって、
やっぱり
ペコリーヌさんたちだったんじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: They were trying their best to hide it. It's not a shame to pretend you didn't see through it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
本人たちは隠してるつもりなんだ。
そこは
知らないふりをしてやるのが
情けってもんさ。

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Ugh, ugh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うっ、
うう……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Umu, so you're awake.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ、
目が覚めたか。

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Aaah?! Wh-What is this...? He's... What happened to my partner?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああっ！？　
な、
なんだこれは……
アイツは……
俺の相棒はどうなったんだ？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: He was promptly defeated. More importantly, you'll be handed over to the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE, so be prepared.
text_block_list.orig_text:
倒しちまったよ。
それよりも
アンタの身柄は【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】に
引き渡すから
覚悟しときな。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: I'm also sure the money you've spent on buying things up must have come from shady means.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうせ買い占めに使った金も
よからぬ方法で手に入れたものじゃろう。

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: What is this... he's already returned to be just a mere minotaur. Dammit... So it was just a one-year dream after all... I was planning to use him to make some more money...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだよ……
もう普通のミノタウロスになっちまってるじゃねえか。
クソ……
結局一年限りの夢だったのか……
アイツを使ってもう一儲けするつもりが……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: You've called him your partner and yet that's how you treat him... How cruel.
text_block_list.orig_text:
相棒なんて言っておきながらそんな扱いって、
ひどいわね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: That's exactly why he ended up being stabbed in the back. Reflect on your actions in the cage.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなだから後ろから刺されるようなことになるんだよ。
檻の中で反省しな。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Now then, is this the luggage that was stolen from you, Sheffy?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて、
シェフィの奪われた荷物はコレかの？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Yes. Good, the contents are safe. Thank goodness... There are a lot of other similar packages. I wonder if they were stolen like mine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ。
うん、
中身は無事ね。
よかった……
他にも似たような荷物がいっぱいね。
これも
私みたいに盗まれたものなのかしら。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: That seems to be the case. Honestly, this one's such a lowlife.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そのようじゃのう。
まったく、
ロクでもない奴じゃ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Ruka, Illya... and {0} too. Thank you so much. It's all thanks to you that we were able to get those things back safely.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルカさん、
イリヤさん……
{0}も。
本当にありがとう。
こうやって無事取り戻せたのも、
みんなのおかげね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: What, it's not a big deal.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なあに。
いいってことさ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Yes. Don't worry about it. So, Sheffy, what are you going to do now? Your luggage is safe, so are you planning to return back to the Gourmets?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うむ。
気にするでないわ。
してシェフィ。
これからどうするんじゃ？
荷物は無事じゃし
そのまま【美食殿】へと帰るかの？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I need a little more help with something, actually. These packages aren't mine... but I'm sure that there's someone out there who was looking forward to those ingredients. Therefore...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう少しだけ
手伝ってほしいことがあるの。
こっちの荷物は、
私のじゃないけれど。
でも、
きっと楽しみに準備していたものだと思うの。
だから……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Whoops. It'd be rude to have you explain the whole thing. You wish to return those packages to their real owners, that it? Leave it to me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっと。
最後までいうのは
野暮ってもんさ。
持ち主に返してやろうっていうんだろ？
任せておきな。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: I used to be Santa Claus, so giving isn't something foreign to me. Let's go, then.
text_block_list.orig_text:
かつてはサンタクロースをしておったわらわには
たやすいものよ。
では、
行こうかの。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Yes. So that everyone can have a happy new year.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ。
みんなが、
幸せな新年を迎えられるように。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Thus, Sheffy's journey continues for a little while longer.
text_block_list.orig_text: こうして、シェフィの旅はもう少しだけ続くのであった。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: After dawn breaks, the four were seen travelling around the country to return any luggage whose owner they managed to identify. Those they couldn't, were sent to the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE.
text_block_list.orig_text:
夜が明けてからは各地を巡り、持ち主の分かる荷物は持ち主へ。
それ以外は【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】へ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And by the time the only luggage that remained was Sheffy's, it was already dusk.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そして、シェフィの持つ荷物が一つになった時には
すっかり夕暮れになっていた。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Ruka-san, Illya-san. For staying with me until the end.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう、
ルカさん、
イリヤさん。
最後まで付き合ってもらって。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: It's fine, I don't really mind.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なあに、
かまわないさ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Sheffy, you should be proud of yourself for pulling it all off.
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィこそ、
よくぞ最後までやり遂げたの。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to you two. I couldn't do it alone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人のおかげよ。
私一人じゃできなかったもの。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we take our leave here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
アタシたちは
ここでお暇させてもらおうかね。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Huh? Since you're here, why don't you come to the guild house? I'd like to thank you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
せっかくだし
ギルドハウスまで来てくれない？
お礼をさせてもらいたいの。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: We don't need any thanks. More importantly, Sheffy. Everyone's waiting for your return, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
礼なぞいらぬわ。
それよりも、
みなシェフィを待っておるぞ？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Hurry up and go home.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ。
早く帰ってやりな。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Thanks, you two!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うん。
ありがとう、
二人とも！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: I just said that we didn't need any thanks... Well then!
text_block_list.orig_text:
礼などいらぬと言うておろうに。
それじゃあの！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. More like, have a good year.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
よいお年を、
ってね。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: If we continue on like this, we'll reach the guildhouse of the Gourmet Guild... It feels like it's been a long time since I've been home. Even though it was only a few days' journey...
text_block_list.orig_text:
このまま進むと、
【美食殿】の
ギルドハウス……
もう
ずいぶんと帰っていない気がする。
ほんの数日の
旅だったはずなのに。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: It's been even shorter since I parted ways with Pecorine and the others. Besides, now I know everyone was always watching over me and helping me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ペコリーヌさんたちと別れてからは、
もっと短い。
それに、
みんなはいつも私を見守って、
助けてくれてたのに……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I can't wait... I want to see them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
早く、
会いたいな。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: When I meet everyone, what should I say and what kind of face should I wear? I've been thinking about it for a long time, but I can't come up with an answer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなに会ったら、
どんな顔で、
なんて言おう。
ずっと
考えてるのに、
答えが浮かばない。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: And yet, my walking speed just keeps getting faster and faster... It's almost time. Once I turn that corner...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それなのに、
歩く速度だけは
どんどん早くなってしまう……
もう、
すぐだ。
あの角を曲がれば……
